concerns.text: FR-006 mandates a conditional switch to Wilcoxon signed-rank test if normality is rejected (p < 0.05). Task T038B only describes performing the Shapiro-Wilk test. There is no explicit task step to implement the conditional logic or execute the Wilcoxon alternative, leaving the requirement unimplemented.

The Plan specifies a 'Repeated Measures Design' with N=500 trajectories. T014 (Generate trajectories) and T049 (Power Analysis) reference generating a 'set' or calculating N, but no task explicitly enforces the N=500 sample size or the specific repeated-measures data structure required for the paired tests in T038.

Spec US-2 requires running experiments across eight distinct LLMs. T009 and T041 define logic to exclude models exceeding 7GB RAM, but no task explicitly selects, enumerates, or validates the list of the eight target models to ensure T024 has a valid candidate list.

Constitution Principle VII and Plan notes require 'neutral-monitoring' logs to be excluded from the primary effect calculation. While T034/T038C mention this, there is no dedicated task to audit or verify this exclusion logic in the final report generation (T051) to prove compliance.

T043 and T044 are listed as 'REJECTED' and unchecked in the text, yet T044A and T051 depend on them. This creates a circular blocking dependency where final validation tasks cannot run because their prerequisites are explicitly marked as missing/failed in the task list.
